name: Poisoned Gifts
description: a creature can contaminate wells, potions, meals, or unattended beverages with poisons that induce sleep, nausea, or paralysis. Someone who drinks or eats the contaminated liquid or food must make a successful DC 11 Constitution saving throw to avoid its effect, which can be unconsciousness, poisoning, or paralysis lasting 1 hour. The effect is chosen by the creature at the time the poison is introduced.
